pack.name: ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS (Architecture Slice)
pack.description: ISMS control themes for architecture evidence. Not ISO 27001 certification.

rules.title: Information asset inventory documented per system
rules.description: Architecture manifests must enumerate information assets (applications, datastores, integrations) with owners so ISMS asset-management scope can be assessed.
rules.remediationGuidance: List primary assets in systemName narrative and services[]; assign ownership tags in governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription.

frameworkMappings.theme: A.5.9 — Inventory of information and other associated assets

rules.title: Asset ownership and accountability assigned
rules.description: Each in-scope service and datastore should name a business and technical owner responsible for classification, access, and lifecycle decisions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record owner contacts in governance.ComplianceTags (e.g., owner:platform-team) and services[].Tags; avoid unnamed shared components.

frameworkMappings.theme: A.5.10 — Acceptable use of information and assets

rules.title: Information classification scheme applied
rules.description: Sensitive workloads must document classification tiers (public, internal, confidential, restricted) applied to datastores and message flows.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag datastores[].Tags and services[].Tags with classification level; align with governance.PolicyConstraints narrative.

rules.title: Labeling of sensitive data in transit and at rest
rules.description: Systems handling classified information must document how labels propagate through APIs, queues, and storage — not rely on implicit trust.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe labeling expectations in governance.RequiredControls; map WritesTo/ReadsFrom edges for classified data paths.

rules.title: Access control policy documented for cloud workloads
rules.description: Manifest governance must state role-based access principles, default-deny posture, and exceptions for break-glass or emergency access.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture access policy in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.RequiredControls; tag identity integration on services[].Tags.

rules.title: Identity provisioning and deprovisioning process
rules.description: Architecture should reference how user and workload identities are provisioned, reviewed, and removed when roles change or systems retire.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document joiner-mover-leaver alignment in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Authentication requirements documented
rules.description: Interactive and service authentication strength (MFA, federated SSO, managed identity) must be explicit for each exposed surface.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag auth mechanisms on services[].Tags; record MFA and federation expectations in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Privileged access management themes
rules.description: Administrative paths to production (subscription owner, cluster admin, break-glass) must be enumerated with justification and monitoring expectations.
rules.remediationGuidance: List privileged roles in governance.PolicyConstraints; document break-glass in metadata.ChangeDescription with expiry and alerting.

rules.title: Access rights review cadence documented
rules.description: Periodic access review for human and service principals should be stated — especially for cross-team shared roles and legacy integrations.
rules.remediationGuidance: Add review cadence tags to governance.ComplianceTags; align RBAC assignments with azureExtractor identity inventory when present.

rules.title: Cryptographic controls for data protection
rules.description: Encryption at rest and in transit expectations must be documented for confidential and restricted assets, including key custody model.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record encryption and key-management expectations in governance.RequiredControls; cite TDE/SSE settings from azureExtractor when available.

rules.title: Key management and rotation themes
rules.description: Customer-managed keys, HSM usage, and rotation cadence should be documented where regulatory or contractual obligations apply.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe CMK/HSM posture in governance.PolicyConstraints and datastores[].Tags; reference Key Vault usage in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Secure configuration baseline for platform services
rules.description: PaaS and IaaS components must reference hardened configuration baselines (private endpoints, TLS versions, disabled legacy protocols).
rules.remediationGuidance: Align services[].Tags with CIS-style hardening themes; document exceptions in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Change management for infrastructure and applications
rules.description: Material architecture changes should trace to approved change records, rollback plans, and separation of dev/test/prod environments.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe change gates in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.RequiredControls; tag environment class on services[].Tags.

rules.title: Vulnerability management integration
rules.description: Architecture must show how container images, dependencies, and cloud resources enter a vulnerability scanning and remediation workflow.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document scanning touchpoints in governance.RequiredControls; tag build pipelines and registries in services[].Tags.

rules.title: Malware and untrusted content controls
rules.description: Ingress paths for user uploads, email, or partner files must document scanning or sandboxing before processing in trusted zones.
rules.remediationGuidance: Enumerate untrusted ingress services and controls in governance.PolicyConstraints and relationships[].relationshipType edges.

rules.title: Logging and monitoring coverage documented
rules.description: Security-relevant events (authn failures, admin actions, data export) must map to centralized logging with retention stated.
rules.remediationGuidance: List log sources in governance.RequiredControls; align with azureExtractor diagnostic settings when inventory exists.

rules.title: Clock synchronization for audit correlation
rules.description: Distributed systems should document time-sync expectations so correlated incident timelines remain trustworthy across regions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note NTP/time-sync assumptions in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.PolicyConstraints for multi-region workloads.

rules.title: Backup integrity and restoration testing
rules.description: Backup scope, encryption, and restore-test cadence must be documented for systems supporting business-critical or regulated data.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe backup tiers in governance.RequiredControls and datastores[].Tags; cross-reference DR narratives in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Business continuity alignment
rules.description: RTO/RPO targets and failover dependencies should be stated so ISMS continuity planning can map to architecture components.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document RTO/RPO in governance.PolicyConstraints; tag tier-1 services and datastores for continuity priority.

rules.title: Security incident response hooks
rules.description: Architecture should identify detection sources, on-call routing, and isolation levers (WAF block, identity disable, network segment drop).
rules.remediationGuidance: List IR integration points in governance.RequiredControls and metadata.ChangeDescription; tag security monitoring services.

rules.title: Supplier and cloud-provider security assessment
rules.description: Third-party SaaS, MSP, and hyperscaler dependencies must be enumerated with security review status and data-processing boundaries.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document suppliers on external WritesTo edges and services[]; add vendor-assessment tags to governance.ComplianceTags.

frameworkMappings.theme: A.5.19 — Information security in supplier relationships

rules.title: Cloud service usage agreements documented
rules.description: Use of shared-responsibility cloud services must reference contractual security commitments, regions, and subprocessors at architecture scope.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture cloud contract themes in governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription; note primary Azure regions on services[].Tags.

frameworkMappings.theme: A.5.23 — Information security for use of cloud services

rules.title: Secure development lifecycle themes
rules.description: Custom code paths should document threat modeling, code review, SAST/DAST gates, and secrets handling before production promotion.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe SDLC gates in governance.RequiredControls; tag CI/CD and repo services in services[].Tags.

rules.title: Separation of development, test, and production
rules.description: Environment boundaries (subscriptions, VNets, identities, data) must be documented to prevent test credentials or data bleeding into production.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag environment class on services[].Tags and datastores[].Tags; state isolation model in governance.PolicyConstraints.

frameworkMappings.theme: A.8.31 — Separation of development, test and production

rules.title: Network security perimeter documented
rules.description: Ingress/egress controls, private connectivity, and east-west segmentation expectations must be explicit for in-scope workloads.
rules.remediationGuidance: Map network zones in metadata.ChangeDescription; align NSG/private endpoint posture with azureExtractor network inventory.

rules.title: Physical security themes for cloud-hosted workloads
rules.description: While physical controls are provider-operated, architecture should document reliance on certified regions and customer access constraints.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note region/certification reliance in governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription for data residency decisions.

frameworkMappings.theme: A.7 — Physical and environmental security (cloud reliance)

rules.title: Privacy and PII handling within ISMS scope
rules.description: Systems processing personal data must cross-reference privacy classifications, retention, and lawful-processing themes in governance metadata.
rules.remediationGuidance: Align PII tags on datastores[].Tags with governance.ComplianceTags; document processing purposes in services[].Purpose.

frameworkMappings.theme: A.5.34 — Privacy and protection of PII

rules.title: ISMS scope boundary documented for the system
rules.description: The architecture review boundary — what is in scope, out of scope, and shared with other systems — must be explicit for assessors.
rules.remediationGuidance: State scope boundary in systemName narrative and metadata.ChangeDescription; list excluded components with rationale.

frameworkMappings.theme: A.4 — Context of the organization (ISMS scope)
